sources.role: authoritative upstream repository; pinned tree contains only README, license, and ignore file
upstream project description and claimed multiplatform Qualcomm BREW/Zeebo HLE scope

linux.reason: The pinned upstream tree contains no executable, build system, emulator source, configuration parser, input backend, save/state implementation, firmware loader, or key path. No controller writer is therefore authorized.

linux-flatpak.reason: No upstream Flatpak or runnable artifact is published in the pinned repository, and no source-backed config/input/firmware/save/state contract exists.

windows.reason: The README claims a multiplatform emulator, but the pinned repository has no implementation or exact Windows artifact from which firmware/BIOS, keys, controller input, saves, or states can be derived.

macos.reason: The README claims multiplatform scope, but no macOS executable, source, configuration, input, firmware, save, or state semantics are present in the pinned tree.
